resources.string: The stack is empty. Press the red button and say what you need to do.
One moment… the microphone is coming back
One moment… turning the microphone on
Without the microphone Tapedo can’t hear your note. Allow the microphone in the phone settings.
This phone has no speech recognition. Install or enable the Google app.
I didn’t hear anything. Press the button and say it again.
Speech recognition couldn’t reach the internet. Check the connection, or download the language for offline use in the phone’s speech recognition settings - then no internet is needed.
Speech recognition is busy with another app. Try again in a moment.
Something went wrong with the microphone. Try again.
Your phone did not accept gap-free recording, so Tapedo records the older way. Recording works, but a word may get lost after a pause.
Send the error - the author will fix it in a next version.
Send the error to the app\'s author
Your mail app opens with a ready message: phone model, Android version and the error code - no notes, no recordings. You send it yourself.
There is no mail app. The error report is on the clipboard - paste it into a message to %1$s.
The phone has no offline pack for this language, so nothing was sent. Online recognition sends your voice to Google. You can also download the offline pack in the phone’s speech recognition settings.
The phone has no offline pack for this language, and online recognition is turned off in Settings. Download the offline pack in the phone’s speech recognition settings.
Tapedo picks the type itself: “buy” is shopping, “at 10” is an event.
A plain note - the text as you say it.
Each thing on its own line, to tick off: “towels, sunscreen, charger”.
One thing to do, with a due date if you say one (“on Friday”).
A loose thought for later - no due date, no priority.
Date, time and place, e.g. “Tuesday at 10 at the dentist”.
A shopping list that sorts itself by aisle: dairy, bakery, produce…
“On silence” ends when you say nothing for a while. “Stop button” keeps listening until you stop it. Short pauses to think never cut anything off.
Continuous recording - pauses cut nothing off.
This phone restarts listening after a pause - go on when the pen is back on the paper.
After the first recording you will see here whether pauses interrupt listening.
This many seconds without new words ends the recording.
A safety net for when you forget to stop.
The language you speak to the phone in. Tapedo’s own texts follow “App language” below.
When the phone has no offline pack for the speech language, online recognition sends your voice to Google.
On phones with on-device recognition (usually Android 12 and newer) your voice never leaves the phone without your consent. On others the system may go online by itself.
Couldn’t save the change. Try again.
Every new card gets this priority (the coloured tape in its corner).
Except: say “urgent” or “important” and it gets high, say “someday” or “no rush” and it gets low. Ideas have no priority.
Makes the text in Tapedo bigger or smaller - on top of the text size set on the phone.
Cards and switches change instantly, without movement. Also on automatically when animations are off system-wide.

Notes are encrypted and stored only on this phone. Tapedo never saves sound - only the text is kept. Nothing leaves the phone unless you allow it: the note text goes to the AI provider you choose, and your voice goes to Google with online recognition.
Tapedo is built from open source libraries and fonts. Their licences follow in their original wording.

AI splits a note into separate cards and lists, spots dates and fixes misheard words. Without AI, simple rules structure your notes: a shopping list after “buy”, an event after “at 10”, priority after “urgent”, a due date after “tomorrow” - it works offline and the note text never leaves the phone.

You can turn on several providers - Tapedo asks them in turn, in the order of this list. When one uses up its daily limit, the next notes go to the next one. When nobody answers, the no-AI rules structure the note.
Very fast, free tier (roughly 1000 requests a day per model, 11.2026).
Many models; free ones have “:free” in the name and a limit of about 50 requests a day (11.2026).
Default model Claude Opus 5.5; claude-haiku-5-5 is cheaper for tasks like this.
Google gives its free plan only to some accounts and projects. Key from Google AI Studio.
A service that runs open AI models very fast. It splits a note into separate tasks and lists. The free plan needs no payment card; it has per-minute and per-day request limits.
One account for many AI models from different companies. It splits a note into separate tasks and lists. Free models have “:free” in the name - about 50 requests a day without topping up.
Claude AI models by Anthropic. They split a note into separate tasks and lists. Paid per use - the account needs credit; one note costs roughly a cent or two (11.2026).
GPT AI models by OpenAI. They split a note into separate tasks and lists. Paid per use - the account needs credit.

Google’s AI model. It splits a note into separate tasks and lists and fixes misheard words. Google gives its free plan only to some accounts and projects - new projects usually work only with billing set up, which is why Gemini is paid here and last on the list. Adults only (18+).

Only the note text goes to Groq (USA) - no recording, no data about you. Under its terms Groq may not use it to train models. By default it stores no requests; for outages it may keep logs for up to 30 days - this can be turned off in the Groq console (Data Controls, Zero Data Retention).

Only the note text goes to OpenRouter (USA) - no recording, no data about you. OpenRouter itself stores no requests unless you turn that on, but it passes them to the company running the model - with free models some of them may train on the text. Such models can be turned off in OpenRouter’s privacy settings; do not dictate sensitive data there (as of 11.2026).

Only the note text goes to Anthropic (USA) - no recording, no data about you. Under its commercial terms Anthropic does not train models on API data and deletes requests automatically within 30 days - longer only for those flagged as breaking its rules (as of 11.2026).
Only the note text goes to OpenAI (USA) - no recording, no data about you. API data is not used to train models unless you opt in; OpenAI keeps it for up to 30 days to detect abuse (as of 11.2026).

Only the note text goes to Google - no recording, no data about you. On the paid plan Google does not use it to improve its products and keeps it for a limited time only to detect abuse. On the free plan (if your project has one), outside the EEA, Switzerland and the UK, Google may use the text and let people read it - then do not dictate sensitive data (as of 11.2026).
Tap “Create a key” - the Groq console opens. Create an account (e-mail, Google or GitHub).
In “API Keys” tap “Create API Key”, name it and copy the key - Groq shows it only once.
Paste the key below and tap “Check connection”. The free plan needs no card.
Tap “Create a key” - OpenRouter opens. Create an account.
In “Keys” tap “Create Key” and copy the key - it is shown only once.
Pick a model with “:free” in the name - only those are free (about 50 requests a day without topping up). Paste the key below and tap “Check connection”.
Tap “Create a key” - the Claude console opens. Create an account.
In “Billing” add credit - without it the key does not work.
In “API keys” tap “Create Key”, copy the key (shown only once), paste it below and tap “Check connection”.
Tap “Create a key” - the OpenAI platform opens. Create an account.
In “Billing” add credit - without it the key does not work.
In “API keys” tap “Create new secret key”, copy the key (shown only once), paste it below and tap “Check connection”.
Tap “Create a key” - Google AI Studio opens. Sign in with a Google account.
On aistudio.google.com/billing set up billing for the project - without it Gemini works only in projects with a free plan (see the “Billing Tier” column; “Free tier unavailable” = paid only).
Tap “Create API key”, copy the key, paste it below and tap “Check connection”.
I keep the key encrypted in the phone’s vault (Android Keystore), never in a plain file, and send it only to this provider. The screen shows the last 4 characters, the whole key - after “Show key”.
The key is missing - without it AI does not work.
The daily limit from the settings is used (requests: %1$d) - Tapedo asks again tomorrow.
%1$s says its daily limit is used - Tapedo asks again tomorrow.
Empty = default: %1$s. Model names are on the provider’s site.
Getting the list from the provider…
Free models - tap one to pick it:
List saved in the app on 7.11.2026 - models change quickly, the provider has the current one.
The provider’s list is not available: %1$s Below is the list saved in the app.
One small request - it counts towards the daily limit.
Requests today: %1$d of %2$d, in the last 30 days: %3$d.
After this many requests to one provider Tapedo waits until tomorrow - a free limit is never overrun.
All providers that are on wait until tomorrow - the no-AI rules structure the notes.
Notes go to the next provider on the list.
Only the note text goes to AI. The recording, keys, other cards and data about you - never.
the key is invalid - check that it was copied whole, or create a new one.
the API is turned off in the provider’s project - turn it on there or create a key in a new project (see “How to get a key”).
this Google project has no free plan - Gemini works in it only with billing (aistudio.google.com/billing), and a new key in the same project will not help. Groq and OpenRouter stay free.
Google wants the project confirmed by phone - open Google AI Studio (“Create a key”) and verify, or turn on another free provider.
the provider refused this account or project - check its site (account, billing, e-mail notices) or turn on another provider.
the model does not exist or is not available for this account - pick another free model.
the provider’s limit is used - Tapedo asks again tomorrow, or right away after a model change.
the daily limit from the settings is used - Tapedo asks again tomorrow.
the saved key could not be read - try again. The key is not lost; if this keeps happening, paste it again.
no connection, or the provider does not answer.
the answer came empty or incomplete - try again or pick another model.
Simple rules wrote these cards instead of the AI:
Couldn’t save the cards. Nothing is lost - try again.
Already saved - you can edit, record more or delete.
Notes can’t be opened right now. Nothing was deleted - try again.
Couldn’t save the change. Try again.

Android lost the key they were encrypted with (it can happen after a system update or a screen lock change), so Tapedo started with an empty stack. The encrypted files were not deleted - they stay in the app’s data, but nobody can read them without the key.
Say what to add to the list, e.g. “butter and eggs”.
What you say is added at the end of the text.
